The '''CI-004 Incident''' was an event that occurred in [[3627 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> on Onderon's largest [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. A group of "overzealous" [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], hunting the wildlife on the moon for [[Jagannath point/Legends|Jagannath points]], attacked [[Czerka Interstellar]]'s [[CI-004 Research Facility]] repeatedly, and successfully breached the compound on their fourth attempt. A strike team recaptured the facility soon after.<ref name="Onslaught" />
